rate_general.source_title: PwC Türkiye - KDV Oranlarında Değişiklik (7346 sayılı Cumhurbaşkanı Kararı, RG 07.07.2023 sayı 32241)
rate_general.notes: Raised from 18% to 20% by Cumhurbaşkanı Kararı No. 7346 dated and published in Resmî Gazete on 07.07.2023 (sayı 32241), effective 10.07.2023 (3 days after publication) per PwC. Corroborated by the Cott page ('10-07-2023 tarihinden itibaren tüm mal ve hizmet tesliminde KDV oranları artırıldı') and by Alomaliye's 7 July 2023 Resmî Gazete item ('Katma Değer Vergisi Oranları, Karar Sayısı 7346') - both seen only as secondary references. Rates are set by Cumhurbaşkanı Kararı within the authority of 3065 sayılı KDV Kanunu md.28 (md.28 reference = background knowledge, not confirmed in the text read); the goods/services lists are those of 2007/13033 sayılı BKK as amended (KPMG's CK 9126 note confirms the 2007/13033 reference). No general-rate change appears in Law 7566 (RG 19.12.2025) summaries by KPMG, PwC and TÜRMOB, nor in PwC's KDV-ÖTV Bülteni 2026/15 (03.07.2026; ÖTV only). Additional 2026 sweep: KDV Genel Uygulama Tebliği Seri No 56 (RG 31.12.2025 sayı 33124 5. mükerrer) only sets the 2026 KDV iade limit (164,000 TL); Seri No 57 (RG 31.01.2026 sayı 33154) deals with exemptions/refund procedure (no rate change); 7582 sayılı Kanun (RG 04.06.2026 sayı 33270) and 7590 sayılı Kanun (RG 31.07.2026 sayı 33326) contain no KDV rate change (7590 only adds a nuclear-power-plant KDV exemption/refund, Geçici md.47, effective 01.08.2026). 7555 sayılı Kanun (RG 24.07.2025) added only narrow exemptions (no rate change). That no later rate decision exists up to 2026-10-01 is NOT proven from the Resmî Gazete itself (not readable) - it rests on the absence of any report of a change in PwC/KPMG/TÜRMOB/BDTurkey bulletins through 31.07.2026 and in the 2026 KDV guides consulted.

rate_reduced.notes: Raised from 8% to 10% by the same CK 7346 (effective 10.07.2023). PwC also notes that soap, shampoo, detergents, disinfectants, wet wipes, toilet paper, paper towels/napkins/tissues moved to the general 20% rate. Item-level list changes continue: CK 9126 (RG 14.11.2024 sayı 32722) per KPMG - special medical foods/pharma inputs at 10%; ÖTV-subject goods and GTİP 85.17 at 20% (single secondary source; effective date not stated in the bulletin).

rate_super_reduced.notes: 1% rate left unchanged by CK 7346 (2007/13033 BKK (I) sayılı liste: temel gıda, gazete/kitap vb.). Start date of the 1% rate is pre-2023 and was not researched. Which goods fall in the 1% / 10% lists was NOT researched - keep the rate user-selectable in calculators.

value.kdv_haric_to_dahil: KDV = matrah x r ; dahil = matrah x (1 + r)   (r = 0.20 / 0.10 / 0.01)
value.kdv_dahil_to_haric: matrah = dahil / (1 + r) ; KDV = dahil - matrah  (identical to dahil x r / (1 + r))
value.kismi_tevkifat: tevkif edilen KDV = hesaplanan KDV x (pay/10) ; satıcı tarafından tahsil edilen KDV = hesaplanan KDV - tevkif edilen KDV
value.rounding_convention: Round half-up to 2 decimals; derive KDV as (dahil - matrah) so the parts always sum to the total. Recommended convention, NOT taken from a legal source.

formulas.notes: Pure arithmetic; matches every worked KDV example in the secondary sources seen, but no primary text was read.

rate_general.source_title: GİB - Kurumlar Vergisi Oranları (table by hesap dönemi)
rate_general.notes: GİB table: 25% default rate for 2025-2026 hesap dönemleri (25% also for 2023 and 2024). Same figure in GİB 'Kurumlar Vergisinde Oran Uygulamaları' (Mart 2026, Yayın No 605, Mükellef Hizmetleri Daire Başkanlığı). Legal basis: 5520 sayılı KVK md.32; GİB's table attributes the 2025+ framework to 7524 sayılı Kanun (RG 02.08.2024). Read through a summary of the GİB document.

rate_finance_group.source_title: GİB - Kurumlar Vergisinde Oran Uygulamaları (Mart 2026, Yayın No 605), pp.12-13
rate_finance_group.notes: 30% applies to kurum kazançları of: bankalar; 6361 sayılı Kanun kapsamındaki şirketler (finansal kiralama, faktoring, finansman); elektronik ödeme ve para kuruluşları; yetkili döviz müesseseleri; varlık yönetim şirketleri; sermaye piyasası kurumları; sigorta ve reasürans şirketleri; emeklilik şirketleri; AND (2025+ tax periods) companies that are contract parties in yap-işlet-devret projects under 3996 sayılı Kanun and in kamu özel iş birliği projects under 6428 sayılı Kanun. The YİD/KÖİ 30% items are quoted verbatim from GİB p.12-13 (and the BDO/İTO presentation) although GİB's own rate table lists only the finance group.

rate_export_earnings.source_title: GİB - Kurumlar Vergisi Oranları (export company row) + Oran Uygulamaları p.26
rate_export_earnings.notes: İhracat kazançlarına 5 puan indirimli oran (25% -> 20%) for 2023 and following tax periods (GİB p.26: 'Kurumların 2023 yılı ve izleyen vergilendirme dönemlerinde elde edilen kazançlarına ... ihracattan elde edilen kazançlara kurumlar vergisi oranının 5 puan indirimli uygulanması'). The reduction covers only the export-earnings share of the kurum kazancı; the apportionment formula was NOT researched.

rate_manufacturing.source_title: GİB - Kurumlar Vergisi Oranları (manufacturing row) + Oran Uygulamaları p.33
rate_manufacturing.notes: 1 puan indirim (25% -> 24%) for kurumlar with sanayi sicil belgesi and actual manufacturing activity, on earnings arising exclusively from manufacturing (GİB p.33). Shown in the GİB table for 2023-2026; legal start date not researched. VALID FOR FY2026. From the 2027 tax period 7582 sayılı Kanun (RG 04.06.2026) introduces a 12.5% rate for qualifying production earnings - see rate_production_from_2027; how the old 1-puan reduction and the 24% row interact with it after 2026 is NOT verified.

rate_production_from_2027.source_title: 7582 sayılı Bazı Kanunlarda Değişiklik Yapılmasına Dair Kanun (RG 04.06.2026 sayı 33270), md.8 - KVK md.32(8) (new) - PwC Vergi Bülteni / KPMG / Grant Thornton / Alomaliye
rate_production_from_2027.notes: NOT valid for FY2026 - do not use in a 2026 calculator. Text quoted by PwC: 'Kurumlar vergisi oranı sanayi sicil belgesini haiz ve fiilen üretim faaliyetiyle iştigal eden kurumların münhasıran üretim faaliyetlerinden elde ettikleri kazançları ile zirai üretim faaliyetiyle iştigal eden kurumların münhasıran bu üretim faaliyetlerinden elde ettikleri kazançlarından %12,5 olarak uygulanır.' Effective for the '2027 yılı ve izleyen vergilendirme dönemleri' (special accounting periods: periods beginning in 2027). Grant Thornton adds that the 12.5% cannot be combined with the extra 5-puan export reduction of KVK md.32(7). Confirmed by four independent secondary sources (PwC PDF, KPMG, Grant Thornton, Alomaliye) that all give the same rate and start year; the Resmî Gazete text itself could not be read (access blocked). Open points: treatment in the 2027 geçici vergi periods, interaction with the 24% row, apportionment for mixed earnings, and the exact KVK paragraph number (PwC: 32(8)).

rate_ipo.source_title: GİB - Kurumlar Vergisi Oranları (halka arz row)
rate_ipo.notes: 2 puan indirim for 5 accounting periods after a halka arz with >= 20% free float (23%). Combined rows in the GİB table: halka arz + ihracat = 18%; halka arz + üretim = 22%.

gecici_vergi_rate_kurum.source_title: GİB - Geçici Vergi Oranları (table) + Oran Uygulamaları p.14
gecici_vergi_rate_kurum.notes: GİB table: kurumlar vergisi mükellefleri 25% for 2025 and 2026 (30% for the finance group; reduced rates apply to geçici vergi too: 'kurum geçici vergi oranı da indirimli olarak uygulanacaktır'). GİB p.14 verbatim: 'Kurumlar vergisi mükellefleri, cari dönemin kurumlar vergisi oranında geçici vergi öderler.' and 'Cumhurbaşkanı, geçici vergi oranını 5 puana kadar indirmeye veya tekrar kanunî seviyesine kadar getirmeye yetkilidir.'

gecici_vergi_rate_gelir_vergisi.source_title: GİB - Geçici Vergi Oranları (gelir vergisi column)
gecici_vergi_rate_gelir_vergisi.notes: Gelir vergisi mükellefleri: 15% (first bracket of GVK md.103 tarifesi) for 2025 and 2026 per GİB table. Part of the income-tax bracket scope; included here only for the geçici vergi calculator.

value.rule: Hesaplanan kurumlar vergisi, indirim ve istisnalar düşülmeden önceki kurum kazancının %10'undan az olamaz.
value.legal_basis: 5520 sayılı KVK md.32/C (added by 7524 sayılı Kanun, RG 02.08.2024)
value.first_period: 2025 and following tax periods (special accounting periods: the one beginning in 2025)
value.exemption: İlk defa faaliyete başlayan kurumlar: not applied for the first 3 accounting periods (EY); tax-exempt kurumlar also excluded (BDO/İTO) - full exception list NOT verified
value.law_7582_change: 7582 sayılı Kanun (RG 04.06.2026) amends KVK md.32/C(2): the reductions under KVK md.10/1 (g), (h), (i) and (j) - quoted by PwC as '10 uncu maddenin birinci fıkrasının; (g), (h), (i) ve (j) bentleri kapsamındaki indirimler' (transit trade 95%/100%, nitelikli hizmet merkezi 95%/100%, İFM financial-service export) - may be deducted from the minimum-tax base; applies to returns that must be filed from 01.07.2026 for kurum kazançları of tax periods beginning 01.01.2026 or later. Grant Thornton lists only (i) and (j); KPMG says transit trade, qualified service centre and financial-service-export reductions - letters differ between sources (UNRESOLVED, immaterial for a standard calculator).
value.base_notes: Kurum kazancı = ticari bilanço karı + KKEG - the specified exemptions/deductions that stay deductible (participation income, emisyon primi, Ar-Ge, serbest bölge etc. per EY). Gayrimenkul satış istisnası (KVK 5/1-e) is NOT deductible from the minimum-tax base (BDO/İTO). The exact list was not verified.

yurt_ici_asgari_kurumlar_vergisi.source_title: EY Türkiye - Yurt içi asgari kurumlar vergisi
yurt_ici_asgari_kurumlar_vergisi.notes: 10% confirmed by EY, PwC (Danıştay bulletin) and the BDO/İTO presentation. GİB's 2026 guides (Yayın 605 and 606) use the term 'Yurt İçi Asgari Kurumlar Vergisi' (Beyan Rehberi §4.3; Oran Uygulamaları pp.120-126) but the percentage was not visible in the excerpts read. WARNING: one summary of GİB's 'Oran Uygulamaları' claimed 'asgari kurumlar vergisi 1.5% of domestic revenues, effective 2020' - it contradicts every other source and is treated as a summary error (do not use). Danıştay 3. Daire (E.2024/5700, 10.02.2025) stayed execution of KVGT (Seri 1) §32.5.4 and §32.5.6 (7th paragraphs and examples 3 and 5), which denied deduction of prior-year losses in the minimum-tax base - final outcome not checked. LATE FINDING: 7582 sayılı Kanun (RG 04.06.2026) widened the deductions allowed from the minimum-tax base (see value.law_7582_change) - this is the only 2026 change to KVK md.32/C found; the 10% rate itself was not changed (no source reports a change).

kuresel_ve_yerel_asgari_tamamlayici_verg.source_title: Yerel ve Küresel Asgari Tamamlayıcı Kurumlar Vergisi Uygulama Genel Tebliği (RG 26.12.2025, sayı 33119)
kuresel_ve_yerel_asgari_tamamlayici_verg.notes: Pillar-Two style top-up tax at 15% under 5520 sayılı KVK (the Tebliğ text as summarised by muhasebetr.com says the law entered into force on 02.08.2024). Applies only to large multinational groups (the EUR 750m consolidated-revenue threshold, filing and payment dates were NOT verified). Irrelevant for a standard corporate-tax calculator; mention only as a footnote.

value.rule: 3-month periods; return filed and tax paid by the 17th day of the 2nd month after the period (23:59). 4th period (Oct-Dec; cumulative Jan-Dec) restored by 7566 sayılı Kanun (RG 19.12.2025 sayı 33112) for tax periods beginning on/after 01.01.2025.
value.scope_of_4th_period: TÜRMOB/KPMG describe the amended GVK mükerrer md.120 for 'ticari kazanç sahipleri ve serbest meslek erbabı'; BDTurkey, vergimerkezi.com.tr and PwC state that kurumlar vergisi mükellefleri file it as well, and PwC's 2026 Mali Takvim lists the corporate 4th-period return for FY2025 (window 01/01/2026-17/02/2026). GİB's own summary table lists 'Feb 17*' for geçici vergi, with an asterisk pointing to Law 7566.

gecici_vergi_periods.source_title: GİB - Beyanname Verme ve Ödeme Süreleri (+ TÜRMOB/KPMG/PwC/BDTurkey/vergimerkezi on 7566)
gecici_vergi_periods.notes: 17th-day rule is verified-official (GİB table). The 4th period and its scope for companies rest on secondary sources (TÜRMOB özel sirküler 154-1, KPMG, PwC 2025/35, BDTurkey, vergimerkezi) plus GİB's asterisked 'Feb 17'. vergimerkezi also says '...genellikle beyan süresi Şubat ayı sonuna kadar' - inconsistent with GİB's 17th-day rule; ignored.

annual_return.value: 1st day of the 4th month after the hesap dönemi end until the last day of that month, 23:59 (calendar-year companies: 1-30 April; for FY2026: 1-30 April 2027); payment within the filing period
annual_return.source_title: GİB - Beyanname Verme ve Ödeme Süreleri
annual_return.notes: GİB Kurumlar Vergisi Beyan Rehberi (Mart 2026, Yayın 606) quote: '2025 Hesap Dönemine Ait Kurumlar Vergisi Beyannamenizi 1-30 Nisan 2026 Tarihleri Arasında Vermeyi Unutmayınız.' 30 April 2027 is a Friday (outside the Oct-Mar window).

value.change: 30% rate group extended to YİD/KÖİ project companies (2025+); yurt içi asgari kurumlar vergisi 10% (KVK 32/C) from 2025 periods; Küresel/Yerel Asgari Tamamlayıcı Vergi 15%.
Stay of execution on KVGT (Seri 1) provisions denying prior-year-loss deduction in the minimum-tax base.
No corporate-tax rate change; 4th geçici vergi period restored from 2025 periods; extension of some temporary provisions (e.g. Geçici 2. madde to 2035); KDV exemptions unrelated to rates.

value.instrument: 7555 sayılı Kanun (RG 24.07.2025) + KVGT Seri No 24 (RG 04.09.2025 sayı 33007)
value.change: Investment-incentive reduced corporate tax (KVK md.32/A) limited to 10 accounting periods for certificates obtained from 24.07.2025 (4 periods for other-income reduction); no change to the 25% general rate or to KVK 32/C.
value.confidence: cross-checked (PwC 2025 bulletin; muhasebetr text of the Tebliğ)

value.change: (1) NEW 12.5% corporate tax rate for qualifying production (sanayi sicil belgesi, fiilen üretim) and agricultural-production earnings from the 2027 tax period (KVK md.32(8)); (2) KVK md.10/1 (i) transit-trade and (j) nitelikli hizmet merkezi deductions raised to 95% (100% in İFM/approved zones) from returns due 01.07.2026 for FY2026 earnings; (3) KVK 32/C(2) lets those reductions be deducted in the minimum-tax base (same dates); (4) İFM financial-service export 100% deduction extended from 2031 to 2047; (5) varlık barışı (KVK Geçici md.19) until 31.07.2027 - 0% to 4% by holding commitment, 5% without commitment, +0.5 puan for notifications 01.01.2027-31.07.2027; (6) 6183 md.48: max tecil period 36 -> 72 months and larger unsecured-tecil limit (1,000,000 TL), effective 04.06.2026; (7) GVK mükerrer 20/D 20-year foreign-income exemption and 1% inheritance tax for relocating individuals (01.01.2026+). No change to the 25% general rate, the 10% minimum tax rate, KDV, damga vergisi or gecikme zammı.
value.confidence: cross-checked (PwC PDF, KPMG, Grant Thornton, Alomaliye, fisle.co title); Resmî Gazete text unread

value.instrument: Yerel ve Küresel Asgari Tamamlayıcı KV Uygulama Genel Tebliği (RG 26.12.2025 sayı 33119)
value.change: Implementing communiqué for the 15% top-up taxes.

value.instrument: 7571 sayılı Kanun md.34 (RG 25.12.2025 sayı 33118) - VUK Geçici md.37 (new)
value.change: NO enflasyon düzeltmesi for the 2025 hesap dönemi (geçici vergi dönemleri included) and for the 2026 and 2027 hesap dönemleri (geçici vergi dönemleri included), whether or not the VUK Geçici 33 conditions are met; special accounting periods: years ending in 2026, 2027, 2028; exception: taxpayers within VUK md.298/A(9) (precious-metals traders); the President may extend by up to three more periods. law_changes_2025_2026.source_title: GİB / EY / PwC / KPMG / BDTurkey (see items)
law_changes_2025_2026.notes: Chronological list of 2024-2026 corporate-tax-relevant instruments found during the research. 7582 and 7590 were found only in a later verification sweep - other 2026 omnibus laws could still exist; checks of the 7582/7590/7555 bulletins found none relevant to rates.

stopaj_standard.source_title: GİB - Serbest Meslek Kazancı Elde Eden Mükellefler İçin Vergi Rehberi (Şubat 2025, Yayın No 549), p.11
stopaj_standard.notes: GVK md.94/2: 'b) Diğerlerinden %20' oranında kesinti yapılır ('ödemeyi yapanlar tarafından'). Rate also in İSMMMO's GVK 94 table (page undated; its navigation references 2026 amounts). Note the sub-paragraph letters: the %20 rate is md.94/2-b (not 2-a). This is the 2025 edition of the guide; no 2026 amendment of GVK 94/2 found (summaries of Laws 7566, 7582 (RG 04.06.2026) and 7590 (RG 31.07.2026) by PwC/KPMG/Grant Thornton/BDTurkey list none; absence of evidence, Resmî Gazete not readable). Withholding applies only when the payer is a withholding agent (kamu idareleri, kurumlar vergisi mükellefleri, bilanço esasına göre defter tutanlar etc. under GVK md.94/1 - full list NOT read); faturaport.com shows 0% stopaj for individual consumers.

stopaj_gvk18.source_title: GİB - Serbest Meslek Kazancı Vergi Rehberi (Şubat 2025), p.11
stopaj_gvk18.notes: GVK md.94/2-a: '(Noterlere serbest meslek faaliyetlerinden dolayı yapılan ödemeler hariç); a) Gelir Vergisi Kanununun 18 inci maddesi kapsamına giren serbest meslek işleri dolayısıyla yapılan ödemelerden %17, b) Diğerlerinden %20, oranında kesinti yapılır.' (GİB guide p.11, verbatim). The kinds of work that fall under GVK md.18 were not researched. Most calculators use 20% only - offer 17% as an option.

kdv_rate_default.notes: SMM services are normally taxed at the general rate. faturaport.com (single source) says 10% for healthcare services; other professions may carry 10%/exempt treatment - NOT researched, so keep the KDV rate user-selectable (0/1/10/20).

danismanlik_denetim_etut_plan_proje.note: GİB özelgesi (03.02.2023, E-62030549-120[65-2021/771]-166939): 'Teknik, ekonomik, mali ve hukuki alanda sunulan danışmanlık, müşavirlik, denetim ve benzeri hizmetler' -> (9/10) KDV tevkifatı. yontemymm.com.tr table (güncelleme 05.01.2026) lists 'Etüt, Plan-Proje, Danışmanlık, Denetim ve Benzeri Hizmetler' at 9/10 for designated buyers.

value.who_applies: Designated buyers per KDV GUT I/C-2.1.3.1/b (yontemymm: kamu kurumları, bankalar, sigorta şirketleri, sendikalar, vakıf üniversiteleri, KİT'ler, KDV mükellefi kurumlar vb.); the buyer list was NOT verified from the Tebliğ itself.
value.minimum_amount_conflict: GİB özelgesi (Şubat 2023): KDV dahil bedel 2.000 TL'yi aşmadığı takdirde tevkifat uygulanmaz. yontemymm.com.tr (Ocak 2026): 'Sınır tutar 12.000 TL (2026) KDV dahil'. faturaport.com (Nisan 2026, nakliye context): 'kısmi KDV tevkifatına konu işlemler için tevkifatlı fatura düzenleme sınırı KDV dahil 12.000 TL', attributed to a 588 Sıra No'lu VUK Genel Tebliği effective 01.01.2026 (second secondary source, not checked against the Tebliğ). The 2026 KDV GUT amendments (Seri 56: only the 164,000 TL iade limit; Seri 57: exemption/refund items) do not touch the tevkifat rates or this threshold. Inference only: the limit was probably raised from 2,000 TL (Feb 2023) to 12,000 TL (2026, KDV dahil) - but the legal source of the 12,000 TL is not confirmed and the point remains UNRESOLVED: do not hard-code; verify in the current KDV GUT (I/C-2.1.3) before launch.

kdv_tevkifat_cases.source_title: GİB özelgesi 03.02.2023 (danışmanlık 9/10) + yontemymm.com.tr KDV kısmi tevkifat tablosu (05.01.2026)
kdv_tevkifat_cases.notes: Only the 9/10 danışmanlık/denetim case is supported by an official GİB document; the others rest on one practitioner site. The full KDV GUT list was not read. KDV tevkifatı applies only if the buyer is a designated withholding agent; otherwise the SMM carries full KDV.

value.inputs: B = brüt serbest meslek bedeli (KDV hariç); s = stopaj rate (0.20 / 0.17 / 0); k = KDV rate; t = tevkifat fraction (0, 0.2, 0.4, 0.9 ...)
value.brut_to_tahsil: stopaj = B x s ; KDV = B x k ; tevkif edilen KDV = KDV x t ; tahsil edilecek (net ödeme) = B - stopaj + KDV - tevkif edilen KDV
value.net_ucret_kdv_haric: B - stopaj = B x (1 - s)   (faturaport: 'Net Ücret = Brüt Tutar x (1 - Stopaj Oranı)')

tavan_2026_h2.source_title: ÇSGB Çalışma Hayatı İstatistikleri E-Bülteni - Temmuz 2026 (Ücret ve Sendikal İstatistikler)
tavan_2026_h2.notes: OFFICIAL ANNOUNCEMENT: Hazine ve Maliye Bakanlığı Kamu Mali Yönetim ve Dönüşüm Genel Müdürlüğü genelgesi dated 02.07.2026 (reference 27998389-010.06.02-4870801), quoted by TÜRMOB document 09.07.2026/98-1: '1 Temmuz 2026 - 31 Aralık 2026 tarihleri arasında geçerli olmak üzere uygulanacak vergiden istisna kıdem tazminatı tutarı 73.729,87 TL'dir.' (legal basis cited there: GVK provisions on the tax-exempt kıdem tazminatı amount, as amended by Law 7103 of 21.03.2018). The genelge PDF itself was NOT readable (kmyd.hmb.gov.tr is a JavaScript site; no direct URL found) - the date/reference come from TÜRMOB's quotation. CSGB confirms the same figure in two official e-bulletins: July 2026 and August 2026 (Sayı 6) - text: 'Kıdem tazminatı tavanı 2026 yılının ikinci yarısında 73.729,87 TL'ye ulaşmıştır'. Arithmetic cross-check: 64,948.77 x 1.1352 = 73,729.87 (+13.52%, the increase quoted by Alomaliye 06.07.2026). Also seen only as titles: Verginet ('Kıdem Tazminatı Tavanı 1/7/2026 - 31/12/2026 Dönemi için 73.729,87 TL Olarak Belirlendi'; page itself WAF-blocked), işletmerotası.com.tr, mertanilguler.av.tr, prozon.net, kariyer.net, Çalışma Genel Müdürlüğü X post. Legal basis of the ceiling (background knowledge, not in the text read): 1475 sayılı Kanun md.14 / ceiling = highest civil-servant retirement gratuity per service year. CSGB's separate 'Kıdem Tazminatı (Temmuz 2026)' PDF and the July 2026 Çalışma Genel Müdürlüğü duyuru page could not be read; the official 1980-2026 PDF as read ended at the 01.01.2026-30.06.2026 row.

tavan_2025_reference.notes: For reference only. The CSGB figure for H1 2025 is 46.655,43 (a figure of 46.655,64 sometimes quoted from memory is NOT the official value).

value.partial_years: Periods beyond a full year are pro-rated; months/12 and days/365 is the common calculator convention (the day-count base is NOT stated in the CSGB FAQ).
value.ceiling: The amount payable per full year of service cannot exceed the tavan in force on the termination date (tavan = max civil-servant retirement gratuity per service year; 1475 sayılı Kanun md.14 reference = background knowledge).
value.wage_basis: giydirilmiş brüt ücret = base pay plus all regular cash and in-kind benefits (yol, yemek, düzenli ikramiye, prim vb.)
value.formula: kıdem = (yıl + ay/12 + gün/365) x min(giydirilmiş aylık brüt ücret, tavan(fesih tarihi))

calculation_rule.source_title: ÇSGB - İş Kanunu Sıkça Sorulan Sorular (Çalışma Genel Müdürlüğü)
calculation_rule.notes: CSGB quotes: 'Her tam çalışma yılı için 30 günlük brüt ücret tutarında kıdem tazminatı ödenmektedir. Bir yıldan artan süreler de oranlanarak hesaplamaya dahil edilmektedir.'; 'Her tam çalışma yılı için ödenen kıdem tazminatı tutarı, fesih tarihinde geçerli olan kıdem tazminatı tavanı ile sınırlandırılmıştır.'; 'Kendisine düzenli olarak sağlanan tüm para ve para ile ölçülebilen menfaatler (yol parası, yemek parası, düzenli olmak koşuluyla ikramiye ödemeleri vb.)'. Official example (Q36): 10 years -> 300 days of wages. Open point: applying the tavan to the 30-day pay of each year (as modelled) is the standard reading and matches the CSGB sentence, but the day-count base for partial years is a calculator choice.

damga_vergisi.source_title: Av. Kazım Ceylan Hukuk Bürosu - Kıdem ve İhbar Tazminatı Vergi Kesintisi (21.09.2026)
damga_vergisi.notes: Damga vergisi on gross kıdem tazminatı: binde 7,59, no ceiling/floor (example: 120,000 TL gross -> 910.80 TL damga -> 119,089.20 net). Alomaliye (06.07.2026) gives the same 0.759%. Both secondary; 488 sayılı DVK (2) sayılı tablo was not read.

value.kidem_tazminati: Gelir vergisinden istisna (GVK md.25/7) up to the legal amount/tavan; the part above the tavan loses the exemption and is taxed at the employee's cumulative bracket.
value.ihbar_tazminati: Not exempt: ücret niteliğinde -> gelir vergisi tevkifatı at the employee's cumulative bracket + damga vergisi 0.759%. Kazım Ceylan notes the asgari ücret (GV/damga) exemption (since 2022) may apply (unverified detail; 2026 asgari ücret brüt 33,030 TL / net 28,075.50 TL per CSGB bulletin).
value.sgk_prim: Both kıdem and ihbar tazminatı are outside prime esas kazanç (no SGK premium).

That the kıdem tavanı does NOT apply to ihbar tazminatı is background knowledge (not stated in the sources read) - unverified.

Her Ay İçin Ayrı Ayrı Uygulanmak Üzere %3,7 Olarak Belirlenmesi Hakkında Karar (Karar Sayısı: 10556)'), KPMG Vergi, PwC Bülten 2025/33, Andersen 44-2025, T24, GAİB (17.11.2025), İstanbul Ticaret Gazetesi (13.11.2025) and STB (14.11.2025). Confirmed by Andersen, PwC 2025/33, T24, GAİB, STB. Transitional rule quoted by Andersen: for applications before 13.11.2025 the old rate applies from the application date until the day before the Tebliğ's publication. tecil_faizi_temporary_29_2026.source_title: Tahsilat Genel Tebliği (Seri: B Sıra No: 20), RG 16.06.2026 - per Osman Arıoğlu (İstanbul Ticaret Gazetesi, 19.06.2026), muhasebetr (16.06.2026), Ekonomi Gazetesi (26.08.2026), müşavirler kulübü (10.07.2026)
tecil_faizi_temporary_29_2026.notes: EXPIRED for new applications on 31.08.2026 (window closed before the 2026-10-01 'today'; no extension reported in the 26.08.2026 column). Context: 7582 sayılı Kanun (RG 04.06.2026) raised the maximum tecil/taksit period of 6183 md.48 from 36 to 72 months and the unsecured-tecil limit to 1,000,000 TL (old limit given as 250,000 TL by PwC/KPMG but 50,000 TL by Grant Thornton/Alomaliye - sources disagree); the Tahsilat Genel Tebliği of 16.06.2026 set tecil faizi at 29% (Arıoğlu: 'tecil faizi oranı 10 puan indirilerek yıllık yüzde 29') for tax-office receivables due on or before 05.06.2026 and unpaid by 16.06.2026, with applications until 31.08.2026 and the first instalment starting in September 2026; instalments by liquidity ratio (0.50+: up to 36; 0.30-0.50: up to 48; below 0.30: up to 72; KDV and BSMV max 12); excluded: ÖTV, 2026 geçici vergi that will be offset against 2026 annual tax, and the related gecikme faizi/damga. Plans granted in the window keep 29% for their life (expectation, not confirmed). The Tebliğ text itself was NOT readable (resmigazete.gov.tr not accessible; gib.gov.tr page returned metadata only; the GİB 'Tecil Faizi ile Taksitlendirilmesi Rehberi' PDF returned HTTP 400). Gecikme zammı stayed at 3.7%/month (Arıoğlu: annual equivalent about 44.4%).

calendar_rules.weekend_holiday_shift: If the last day of a VUK period falls on a Saturday, Sunday or official full-day holiday, the period ends at 23:59 of the next working day (VUK md.17 as summarised by Ekonomi Gazetesi: 'sürenin ... tatili izleyen ilk iş günü ... uzaması'). The VUK/mevzuat text itself could not be read.
calendar_rules.half_days_and_idari_izin: Half-day holidays (arife) and idari izin days are NOT treated as shifting days (Ekonomi Gazetesi, 13.08.2025 - single secondary source). GİB can nevertheless extend deadlines by circular: VUK Sirküler/199 (15.05.2026, VUK mükerrer md.28) moved MPHB/damga/konaklama from 26.05 to 03.06.2026 and KDV from 01.06 to 05.06.2026; the e-Defter circular of 08.06.2026 (VUK md.242) moved the 10 and 15 June deadlines to 30 June 2026. Watch GİB announcements before the Cumhuriyet Bayramı and Ramazan Bayramı windows.
calendar_rules.sgk_premium: Premiums are payable by the end of the month following the month of the wages (employees paid between the 1st and 30th); for pay periods running 15th-14th the date is the 14th of the following month. If the last day is an official holiday: first working day after the holiday (SGK page). The SGK page mentions only 'resmî tatil'; a Saturday/Sunday shift is standard practice but not stated there.
